Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 17 s. 2023 MAR 22 2023 MR. PAUL JAMES CASTILLON Former SK Chairman Barangay Lower Taway Ipil, Zamboanga Sibugay <pauljamescastillo@gmailcom> Dear Mr. Castillon: This pertains to DILG Legal Opinion No. 129, s. 2022 dated October 14, 2022 issued by this Department in response to your clarification on the Grant of Barangay Official Eligibility to a former Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Chairperson. This erratum notice is issued to correct the error that was inadvertently cited in Legal Opinion No. 129, s. 2022, specifically, Republic Act (RA) No. 8524, entitled: AN ACT CHANGING THE TERM OF OFFICE OF BARANGAY OFFICIALS AND MEMBERS OF THE SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN FROM THREE (3) TO FIVE (5) YEARS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SETION 43 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. .7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES. RA No. 8524 is already amended by RA No. 10742 or the SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN REFORM ACT OF 2015, relative to the term of office of the SK Chairman and members of the SK, Section 11 thereof provides: SECTION II. Term of Office. — (a) The chairperson and members of the Sangguniang Kabataan shall hold office for a fixed term of three (3) years unless sooner removed for cause, permanently incapacitated, have died or resigned from office. Xxx (Emphasis ours) Be that as it may, we stand with our view that you are still not entitled to the grant of Barangay Official Eligibility (BOE). While it is true that you were already in the service for four (4) years — which is already beyond three years, may we emphasize that on December 3, 2019, RA No. 11462 was enacted, postponing the May 2020 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections, wherein, the incumbent SK officials are mandated to remain in office, Section 3 thereof states: SEC 3. Hold-Over. — Until their successors shall have been duly elected and qualified, all incumbent barangay and sangguniang kabataan officials shall remain in office, unless sooner removed or suspended for cause: Provided, That barangay and sangguniang kabataan officials who are ex officio "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

members of the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, or sangguniang panlalawigan, as the case may be, shall continue to serve as such members in the sanggunian concerned until the next barangay and sangguniang kabataan elections. (Emphasis ours) The cited provision connotes continuity of term of office until the successors have been duly elected and qualified. Further, the said provision uses the word "shall" in the phrase "shall remain in office" which is mandatory in nature. Accordingly, you were not able to complete the term of your office that would warrant the granting of a BOE, as completion of term refers to the term of office as specified by the prevailing lawl. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY Und o RITY OF THE SECRETARY: AN VICT R R. LLAMAS retary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs JVRULLLS-LRALLD/rrao 1 CSC Memorandum Circular No. 13, 2.2012 Page20f2
